# Ambi's ear: lines Ambi refused, in Ambi's words. The only judge that outranks a check.

> Working document. Subject to change through continued conversation.

| When | Line | What Ambi said |
|---|---|---|
| 24 Nov 2026, about 21:00 | "the sun gave nothing" (ten minute film, gemini-4-neon, the wording came from an Opus brief; the lead and two Opus listeners praised it) | "The sun gave nothing. What kind of slop is that?" ... "weird random poetic words that doesn't connect to anyone. No matter the niche." |

What Ambi ordered in the same message: "take scriptwriting skeletons from scripts of videos you watched"; "go on my browser ... look on my YouTube ... find like a bunch of videos. And get different script writing skeletons for the four to six ... Understand the skeleton behind them and then you can multiply, and use different bends and structures for those scripts"; "Gemini is very capable of writing good scripts. But the structures and how it does it, and the architecture that we build behind the software itself ... got to be good to allow it to flourish".

Lead's reading: no judge that shares the writer's or the builder's taste may pass a script. A judge is trusted only after it refuses every line in this table, unprompted, planted in good text.
